content.h2: TK889 Bonus FAQ — Wagering, Cashback & Free Spins

content.title: Which TK889 bonus gives the best value?
content.text: For a new account, the 100% welcome match up to ৳16,000 at 16x wagering. For regulars, weekly cashback wins because it pays as withdrawable cash with no playthrough at all.

content.title: Can I withdraw bonus money before clearing wagering?
content.text: Your own deposit stays withdrawable, but the bonus and anything won from it stays locked until the 16x requirement is met. Requesting a payout early forfeits the bonus portion.

content.title: What happens after the 21-day limit?
content.text: Unfinished bonuses expire along with winnings generated from them. Your original cash balance is untouched, so nothing you deposited disappears.

content.text: Slots at 100% contribution. Live tables count 10% and crash titles in the games section count 5%, so stick to reels while a bonus is active.

content.title: Is there a bonus for installing the app?
